Main evaluation's latest full v9: TP13 FN8 FP2 TN17, recall 0.62, precision 0.87, type agreement 12/22, timecode median 1.9s, about 32s/clip. entries.limitations: In-sample optimistic scores, tiny per-type samples and no held-out new camera. Do not merge main v9/v10 and alternate v8 metrics into one version, or compare speeds across GPUs. Safe-lock keys and some door/procedural cues fail; v8 raises false alerts on9/19 normal clips and can obtain correct video verdict for wrong reason.
